arkivar.epost.finnes.emne: You already have an account in {appnavn}
arkivar.feil.alt_behandlet: The document has already been processed. Undo it to process it again.
arkivar.feil.avsender: Enter the name of the sender (at most 200 characters in each field).
arkivar.feil.dokument_ferdigstilt: The document is finalised and cannot be changed.
arkivar.feil.dokument_ikke_utfylt: The document still has a square bracket from the template in the title, subject, recipient, text or attachments. Replace it before you finalise.
arkivar.feil.dokumentdato: The document date must be a valid date that is not in the future.
arkivar.feil.dokumenttekst: The document must have text, at most 80 paragraphs of at most 5000 characters each.
arkivar.feil.domene: The email address must be from an approved institution. If your teacher has given you a class code, you can register with that.
arkivar.feil.domene_finnes: The domain is already in the list.
arkivar.feil.domenenavn: Enter a valid domain name, for example uis.no.
arkivar.feil.emne: The subject must be between 3 and 300 characters.
arkivar.feil.epost_finnes: The email address already has an account.
arkivar.feil.epost_sending: We could not send the email. Try again in a little while.
arkivar.feil.for_mange_versjoner: The document can have at most 30 versions. Save without a new version, or finalise the document.
arkivar.feil.handling: Choose what should happen to the document.
arkivar.feil.ikke_bekreftet: The email address is not confirmed. Enter the code you received by email, or ask for a new one.
arkivar.feil.ikke_skrevet: The entry has no document that can be changed.
arkivar.feil.ikke_til_avslutning: The folder is not awaiting closure.
arkivar.feil.ikke_til_journalforing: The document is not awaiting journaling.
arkivar.feil.ikke_til_kontroll: The folder is not awaiting control.
arkivar.feil.journalpost_fra_postmottak: The registration belongs to a document from the mail room. Undo the handling of the document to remove it.
arkivar.feil.journalpost_fulgte_med: The document came with the archive and cannot be deleted.
arkivar.feil.klasse: Choose a primary classification that exists in the series: a class without subclasses in the classification scheme, or an entry in the register.
arkivar.feil.klassekode: The class code does not exist. Check the code your teacher gave you.
arkivar.feil.klassenavn: Give the class a name (at least two characters).
arkivar.feil.kode: The code is wrong or has expired. Ask for a new code and try again.
arkivar.feil.krever_mappe: A document that goes into the archive is registered in the file it belongs to. Find or create the file first.
arkivar.feil.mappe_avsluttet: The file is closed. A new document cannot be registered in it.
arkivar.feil.mappe_fulgte_med: The file came with the archive and cannot be deleted.
arkivar.feil.mappe_har_restanser: The folder cannot be closed until all the documents in it are journaled.
arkivar.feil.mappe_ikke_tom: The file has documents and cannot be deleted.
arkivar.feil.mottaker: An outgoing document must have a recipient on the sheet (at most 500 characters).
arkivar.feil.navn: Enter your name (at least two characters).
arkivar.feil.offentlig_tittel: The public title can be at most 500 characters.
arkivar.feil.oppgave: The document does not exist in the mail room.
arkivar.feil.opptatt: Many are resetting their training archive at the same time. Try again in a moment.
arkivar.feil.part: Enter who the document is from or to (at most 300 characters).
arkivar.feil.saksmal: The file template does not exist.
arkivar.feil.sakstittel: Give the file a title (at least three characters).
arkivar.feil.siste_administrator: This is the last active administrator. Give another user the role first.
arkivar.feil.skjerming_uten_hjemmel: Screening must have a legal basis. Choose an access code, or remove the screening.
arkivar.feil.tilgangskode: The access code does not exist.
arkivar.feil.tittel: Give the record a title (at least three characters).
arkivar.feil.tittel_ikke_utfylt: The title still has a bracket from the suggestion. Replace it with what applies to the case.
arkivar.feil.vedlegg: At most 20 attachments, each of at most 200 characters.
arkivar.hendelse.journalpost.journalfort: Document journaled by the records office
arkivar.hendelse.journalpost.registrert: Journal entry registered without a document from the mail room
arkivar.hendelse.postmottak.behandlet: Document in the mail room processed
